object_description: two-story building with a floating overhanging upper volume
design_condition: The compact building is embedded in the gently rising slope and forest clearing, with its set-back ground floor compensating for terrain changes and the overhanging upper volume creating covered arrival and break areas.

positive.statement: The building fits well into the surroundings despite its large footprint.

position.rationale: Compact overhanging mass is clearly visible across the top and elevation views.

positive.statement: The open space concept weaves forest, groups of trees, herbaceous fringe and meadow into the new school building.

position.target: forest, trees, herbaceous fringe and meadow
position.rationale: Landscape features are not sampled, so the south-east perimeter provides a constrained site anchor.

positive.statement: The building volume is intelligently placed in the forest clearing and strengthens the spatial conditions through new plantings.

position.rationale: The building mass is visible, while the forest clearing and plantings require an approximate site placement.

positive.statement: The compact building volume enables different uses to be arranged naturally, well exposed to the sun and accessible by wheelchair.

position.rationale: The compact stepped volume is visible; use-related and accessibility qualities are not geometrically distinguishable.

positive.statement: The ground floor is designed and organized in a very practical and user-oriented manner.

position.rationale: The lower set-back level is identifiable in elevations and anchored toward the north-west footprint.

positive.statement: The rooms are well positioned in relation to access, exposure and the outside.

position.target: rooms in relation to access, exposure and outside
position.rationale: Exterior-facing upper volume provides a plausible anchor for rooms relating to access and outside.

positive.statement: The vertical access at the center promises the shortest possible paths on all sides.

position.rationale: Central placement is supported by the top-view void and surrounding stepped massing.

positive.statement: The project impresses with its precision, well-placed building volume, innovative design features and sympathetic materialization.

position.target: well-placed building volume and design features
position.rationale: Stepped overhangs and atrium cuts are visible across the complete calibrated view set.

negative.statement: The windmill-like arrangement produces very winding and narrow corridors on the upper floors, making orientation difficult.

position.rationale: Upper-level circulation is constrained to the winding perimeter and internal stepped geometry.

negative.statement: The location of the offices and therapy rooms on the first floor is criticized.

position.rationale: The first-floor level is visible, but offices and therapy rooms are not individually distinguishable.

negative.statement: The kindergartens' location on the second floor prevents direct outdoor access.

position.rationale: Second-floor volume is visible, while kindergarten placement is inferred near the north-west upper perimeter.

negative.statement: The open central staircase is not tolerated for fire-safety reasons, and the atriums would require elaborate fire compartments.

position.rationale: Central opening and surrounding atrium incisions are visibly expressed in plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The large cubature and graduated atrium incisions require very large and expensive facade processing.

position.target: large cubature and graduated atrium incisions
position.rationale: Large stepped massing and facade-edge incisions are visible on the south-east exterior.

negative.statement: The high proportion of glass has a negative impact on gray energy.

position.rationale: The south-facing facade supplies a constrained anchor; glazing proportion is not materially resolved by points.

negative.statement: The area and volume efficiency, complex facade construction and expensive courtyards lead to high investment costs.

position.rationale: Broad efficiency and investment concerns are anchored across the visible stepped building and courtyard cuts.
